_comment: Three separate facts, deliberately not one field. 'translated' lists pages whose copy is finished; that turns ON the quality checks (leftover-English scan, blog-title agreement). 'live' lists language trees that are actually published; that turns OFF noindex and puts pages into sitemap.xml, the hreflang sets and the language switcher. 'holdback' lists pages that are finished and sit in a live tree but are NOT approved to publish yet - the proofread gate. Without it, finishing a translation in a live tree would publish it the same instant, and .claude/rules/writing.md is explicit that machine translation is never shipped unproofread. A tree can be fully translated and still not live; a page can be translated, in a live tree, and still held. See .build/cutover.md.
_holdback_comment: Empty by explicit instruction on 2026-08-15: the client asked twice for all four languages live now, having been told what it means. Everything here is model-produced copy that has been cold-reviewed and corrected but not read by a native speaker. Re-holding any page is one line: put its slug back under its language key here and re-run fix-head.ps1 + gen-sitemap.ps1 + gen-llms.py. See .build/proofread-notes-*.md for what a native reader should look at first.
